limitations: All scores are provisional browser evaluations based on the attached screenshots and supplied runtime account; I did not independently rerun the browser checks.
The authorized A>=9 and F>=9 threshold is not met for every screen and component; several observed density, hierarchy and validation treatments remain below it.
No hard-gate failure is established by the supplied evidence; offscreen content in scrolled captures is not treated as inaccessible when browser reachability is explicitly reported.

The schema provides six dimension fields but no separate aggregate fields; A, F and weighted overall scores can be calculated using the supplied rubric, excluding genuinely inapplicable null dimensions.

Physical iPhone, Dynamic Type, native keyboard, audible VoiceOver, native animation performance, OS sharing/clipboard/notifications and real payments remain unverified without deductions solely for those deferred boundaries.
Authenticated Circles behavior is not demonstrated because its service is unconfigured; the scores assess the represented offline and retry experience.
Source destinations, sharing and clipboard boundaries include mocks, and billing is simulated; these establish browser presentation and controlled recovery rather than external service success.
Synthetic long-text fixtures establish layout stress and content retention, not production wording defects, source credibility or predictive quality.
Most compositions were captured at a986c44a, while the supplied current-head evidence at 0a6de9b0 specifically verifies the subsequent settings visibility correction.
Transition stills support visual comparison but cannot establish motion quality alone; animation assessments additionally rely on the supplied browser path and performance measurements.
topFixes: Give birthday validation a visible field-level or date-group error treatment alongside its specific message.
Make outcome selection and saving dominate enlarged check-in screens instead of the repeated forecast.
Condense repeated context, omen-policy and saved-status prose while preserving the actual disclosures and state distinctions.
Improve navigation through long answers, legacy explanations and sources without rewriting or truncating authored content.
Tighten enlarged plan-option grouping and populated history summaries.
Increase expanded-editor text inset and make the ready share preview more informative.
